name: What are some common mistakes to avoid when planning garage storage?

mainEntity.name: What are some common mistakes to avoid when planning garage storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes in garage storage planning include underestimating storage needs, failing to utilize vertical space, and choosing unsuitable materials for the garage environment. Many people buy insufficient storage or solutions that don't fit their items. Neglecting overhead or wall space leaves valuable floor area cluttered. Using materials not resistant to temperature fluctuations, moisture, or heavy loads can lead to premature wear and damage. It's also a mistake to ignore safety by overloading shelves or not securing wall-mounted units properly. Proper planning considers all items, available space, and environmental factors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating needs, ignoring vertical space, using inadequate materials, and overlooking safety when planning garage storage.
